agent_note: Third-person past narration of a WWI-era English ensemble (Beatrice, Hugh, Daniel, Agatha), very dialogue-heavy: 26 of 45 quotes are speech. Quotation marks survive on most, but roughly nine excerpts have the marks stripped by Goodreads; those were assigned on vocatives, second-person address, first-person deixis, trailing tag commas, and exclamatory register, each recorded per quote. 14 event quotes, all past, zero present. Only q01443 dissents and it is abstained rather than counted. Gnomic quotes are all present-tense aphorisms; three past-tense generalizations (q01410 among them) were kept as event/past per the present-only rule.
